description: This Java source file defines the class SlidingTabLayout, a custom view component for Android that provides a scrollable tab indicator linked to a ViewPager, enabling users to navigate between pages with visual feedback. It includes interfaces for customizing tab colors and supports custom tab layouts.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout
classes.description: A custom view extending HorizontalScrollView that displays a set of tabs linked to a ViewPager, with customizable colors and layout.

classes.name: TabColorizer
classes.description: An interface allowing customization of indicator and divider colors for each tab.

methods.name: createDefaultTabView
methods.description: Creates a default TextView to serve as a tab view, with styling for gravity, size, typeface, background, and padding.

methods.name: populateTabStrip
methods.description: Populates the tab strip with views representing each page of the ViewPager, using custom or default tab layouts.

methods.name: scrollToTab
methods.description: Scrolls the HorizontalScrollView to make the selected tab visible, accounting for partial scroll offsets.
